payload.title: Who writes the /goal prompt for a Goal: hyp from the log, or a skill?
payload.body: Today the repo skill hyp-owner-grill has the skill write the prompt by hand, and nothing prints it. The prompt must serve any Goal and carry its constraints block. Scenarios that separate the rivals: (1) generate the prompt twice from one log and compare bytes; (2) generate it for a body whose block is invalid and observe the exit status; (3) generate it for a Goal in a two-Goal store.

why: Owner-flow design question of #113, settled in the grill session of 2026-11-12

payload.title: hyp prompt prints the /goal prompt from the log
payload.body: A command reads the log and prints the store directory, the actor, the Goal id, the skill, the stop clauses and the Goal body block unchanged. Same log and flags give the same bytes; an invalid block exits 1; it writes nothing.

payload.title: A skill writes the /goal prompt from hyp show and hyp status
payload.body: The owner-flow skill composes the prompt text by hand from the tree and copies the block lines. The text varies between sessions, and no exit status refuses an invalid block.

payload.title: Settle the prompt form by the three scenarios, in the grill session
payload.body: Rule, fixed before the Result: the owner settled in the session of 2026-11-12 that hyp prints the prompt (rival 1). Rival 2 is contradicted when any scenario cannot hold for a prompt a skill writes: (1) the same log gives the same bytes; (2) an invalid block is refused with exit 1; (3) a two-Goal store gives only the asked Goal. No run executes these; the scenarios file records the argument.

why: Decided in the session, so recorded as an Experiment with a reading rule

payload.observation: Session decision, recorded as the Experiment Result: the owner chose hyp prompt (rival 1) on 2026-11-12. The three scenarios are argued in the cited file, not executed. Rival 2 fails all three; rival 1 holds all three. verdict: H-108P9D=supports H-8TPB9X=contradicts

why: Session decision of the owner, recorded as the Experiment Result

payload.title: Which hyp commit implements the #113 owner flow: hyp prompt and the constraints block?
payload.body: The candidate is a hyp commit. The run adds each commit as a Hypothesis with its subject, and a fix as a new Hypothesis that supersedes it.
